# Excalidraw

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A sketching tool with rich capabilities for drawings with many extensions for scripts for additional features.

## Scope note

- Allows embedding of drawings in notes.
- Enables linking to documents and other drawings.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
